The bandits are defeated. {0} of {1} thanks you.

Leave the settlement to the lord: +{3} goodwill. Everything still in the settlement belongs to {1} again. Taking items or claiming buildings there costs goodwill. Items your colonists already carry count as taken.

Take what is left: +{4} goodwill. The settlement stays with the bandits and you can loot freely.

If you leave the map without deciding, you take what is left.
